title: Stack-based buffer overflow in certain ASUS Router firmware allows an unauthenticated nearby attacker to execute…
description: A stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in certain ASUS Router firmware versions. This flaw allows an unauthenticated attacker within network proximity to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges by sending a specially crafted device name. The vulnerability is rated high severity with a CVSS score of 8.7. No specific affected versions or patch information are provided in the available data.
